{{Quote|The Imperial Navy regrets to announce that unusual solar activity caused the crash of the supply ship ''Ambitious'' at the B'Knos mining colony in the Abran asteroid belt. The resulting explosion claimed the lives of all miners at the colony.|[[Imperial HoloVision]] news release|<ref name="TBSB" />}}
During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium]] '''raided''' a number of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] outpost [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] along the edge of civilized [[Realspace/Legends|space]], enslaving their [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists through a process known as "[[entechment]]," as part of a deal struck with [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], who craved the [[Alien/Legends|aliens]]' technology. One such colony world was [[B'Knos]], which the [[Ssi-ruu]]k raided in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].

==Prelude==
When [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] made contact with the alien invaders called the [[Ssi-ruu]]k, he made a deal with them: In exchange for their [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] technology, the invaders were allowed to attack smaller colonies at the edge of [[Wild Space/Legends|colonized space]]. The B'Knos mining colony in the [[Abran asteroid belt]] was one of these.<ref name="TBSB" />

==The battle==
The Ssi-ruuk raided the planet B'Knos.<ref name="Geo">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

==Aftermath==
Since the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] wanted to keep the presence of the Ssi-ruuk a secret, the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] released a cover-up story at 35:8:16, which was published through [[Imperial HoloVision]] and [[Galaxywide NewsNets]]. According to it, the supply ship ''[[Ambitious]]'' crashed into the mining colony due to interferences of the local [[Abran|star]] and the mineralogical composition of the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]]. The [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the ''Ambitious'', [[Vin Freen]] was posthumously awarded for his bravery, since he tried to stop the disaster by destroying his own ship.<ref name="TBSB" />

Nonetheless, rumors escaped about this and other incidents and [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] whispered about them in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]].<ref name="Geo" />
